subject: POC final readout & exec decision - Novacare
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@novacare.com>, Amy Zhang <amy.z@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC final readout - Novacare

Hi Carlos / Amy,

Thanks again for running the POC with us this month — really appreciate the team's collaboration. Quick recap from today's call and proposed next steps so we're aligned heading into the final readout: 

Summary of POC scope:
- Inference throughput and tail latency for our two primary workloads (clinical summarization and search reranking).
- Integration verification with Novacare's VPC + KMS.
- Output quality validations against the evaluation set you shared.

Success criteria (as discussed):
1) 95th percentile latency under 220ms for summaries at 512 tokens under your baseline workload.
2) Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) improvement of >= 12% on reranking test set.
3) KV cache + batching integration with no more than one SRE incident during trial.

Ownership / evaluation plan:
- Novacare: provide final eval labels and confirm go/no-go decision framework (Amy / Carlos).
- Redwood: provide final readout deck, evaluation matrix, and a 30-minute live demo of the integrated flow (Marissa / Marcus).
- Success metric owner: Amy to validate MRR and sign off; Carlos to confirm latency numbers with infra team.

Timeline (proposed):
- Aug 26: Redwood sends readout materials (deck + evaluation matrix) — ATTACHED.
- Week of Aug 31 / Sept 1: Final readout & exec review; decision window and procurement next steps.
- Sept 3–10: If go, kickoff draft MSA and SOW discussions; if no-go, retrospective notes and feedback session.

Attachments: novacare_poc-readout-deck.pdf, novacare_evaluation_matrix.xlsx (see attached).

Ask / next steps:
- Please confirm the proposed readout window (Sept 1–2) and who from Novacare will be in the exec decision meeting.
- Also confirm any procurement/legal contacts we should loop in if the exec decision is positive.

Thanks — I can be flexible on timing next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

From: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@novacare.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Amy Zhang <amy.z@novacare.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC final readout - Novacare

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for the attachments. Quick confirmations from our side: 

- Success criteria look right; one tweak: for latency we'd like to verify 95th percentile under 250ms for the initial environment, with plan to optimize to 220ms in week 1 of production. If that margin is achievable in the readout, we can mark it as green.
- For MRR, Amy will own the final sign-off but the threshold of 12% is aligned with our expectations.

Readout attendees and exec decision process:
- Execs: CTO (Ravi Patel) and Head of Product (Amy Zhang) will attend the readout for a final go/no-go.
- Procurement: please also include our procurement manager, Lindsay Park (lindsay.park@novacare.com), once we have a positive exec signal.

Timing: Wed Sep 2 at either 10:00 or 11:00 PT works best for us — a 30–40 minute slot should suffice for the demo + Q&A. 

I'll loop Lindsay once we have a confirmed slot and draft MSA.

Thanks,
Carlos
Senior Engineering Manager, Novacare

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: POC final readout - Novacare (internal planning)

Marissa / Neha — internal notes after Carlos' reply. Capturing owners and prep items so we don't scramble next week: 

1) Readout deck: Marissa to lead slides 1–8 (POC summary + metrics), Marcus to demo integrated flow (30 min), Neha to cover contract/timeline and draft MSA handoff (5–7 min).
2) Tech prep: Marcus / infra to run one last latency sweep in a staging VPC that mirrors Novacare's env; deliver results by EOD Mon Aug 31.
3) Evaluation matrix: Marissa to mark the cells that require Novacare verification (labels/MRR tests).
4) Logistics: Neha, can you generate a short mutual action plan doc and share a DocuSign link for the draft MSA if execs say go? Also confirm availability for Wed Sep 2 10:00–11:00 PT (tentative).

Quote from Carlos: 
> "Readout attendees and exec decision process:
> - Execs: CTO (Ravi Patel) and Head of Product (Amy Zhang) will attend the readout for a final go/no-go.
> - Procurement: please also include our procurement manager, Lindsay Park (lindsay.park@novacare.com), once we have a positive exec signal."

I'll validate staging latency numbers and drop them into the shared drive link.

Thanks — Marcus
